<!-- Write in first person. State facts, not adjectives. Use 300 to 900 words. Do not include a home address, phone number, national ID number or names of other people. -->
# Profile
<!-- Describe your own work needs. Do not copy another person's profile. -->

## Who I am
<!-- State your work, experience, education and skills with concrete examples. -->

What do you do today? I build data tools for an invented public library.
How many years of relevant experience do you have, and in which kinds of work? I have seven invented years of data engineering experience.
What education, training or qualifications do you want the judge to know about? I hold an invented computer science degree from Fictional College.
What are your strongest skills, and how have you used them? I use Python and SQL to build tested data pipelines.
Which tools, equipment or methods can you use with confidence? I use invented Python, SQL and Linux systems each week.

## What I want next
<!-- Describe the duties and responsibility you want next. -->

What should be different in your next job? I want to build useful data tools for an invented community.
Which roles or kinds of work would you most like next? I want data engineer or software developer roles.
Which other roles would you consider, even if they are not your first choice? I can also consider an invented analytics engineer role.
What level of responsibility do you want in the next job? I prefer an experienced individual contributor role.
Do you prefer leading people, specialist work, a mix, or neither? I prefer specialist work with occasional mentoring.

## What makes a job exceptional for me
<!-- State which evidence would make a job worth acting on. -->

Which subjects, services or industries interest you? I prefer invented libraries and other public information services.
What kind of employer or workplace would suit you? I prefer a stable invented public or nonprofit employer.
What kind of team and support do you work best with? I want a small supportive team with clear responsibilities.
How do you like work to be planned and carried out? I prefer code review, automated tests and calm delivery.
What would make a job exceptional enough for you to act on it? An exceptional job lets me improve useful public data tools.

## What I do not want
<!-- Describe unwanted duties or workplaces without inventing strict limits. -->

Which tasks do you want to avoid? I prefer not to spend most of the week on sales calls.
Are there subjects, services or industries you do not want to work in? I prefer not to work on invented gambling products.
Are there kinds of employer or workplace you would not consider? I prefer not to join an invented employer with unclear duties.

## Hard limits
<!-- Use a bullet list. Each bullet must start with STRICT: and contain an explicit personal limit. Leave skipped answers unknown. -->

- STRICT: Minimum annual salary is 701,000 NOK before tax for full-time work. If the ad does not state salary, salary compatibility is unknown.
- STRICT: Equally acceptable work arrangements: on-site, hybrid. An explicitly incompatible arrangement fails; an unstated arrangement remains unknown.

## Preferences
<!-- Use bullets that start with PREFER: for wishes that are not strict limits. -->

- PREFER: Which language requirements can you meet, and which can you not meet? I can work in invented Norwegian and English environments.
- PREFER: How much work travel, including overnight stays, can you accept? I prefer occasional planned travel rather than weekly travel.
- PREFER: Are there security-clearance requirements you cannot or do not want to meet? I have no invented security clearance to declare.
- PREFER: Which contract types and durations can you accept? I prefer a permanent invented employment contract.
- PREFER: What working hours, shifts and amount of work can you accept? I prefer ordinary daytime work with predictable hours.
What notice period or earliest start date should the judge know about? My invented notice period is three months.

## Examples
<!-- Give yes and no job examples and explain each choice. -->

Name one or two jobs or employers you would say yes to today, and explain why. An invented library data engineer role would interest me.
Name a job or employer you would say no to today, and explain why. An invented commission-only sales role would not interest me.

## Notes for the reviewer
<!-- State uncertainties and explain what the ad must establish. Do not invent missing facts. -->
